name: Mortalfin
description: A native Jellyfin client for the PS5 with a cover-wheel interface, HDR and surround sound passthrough. Beta.
author: mortaljinx
release_notes:
Second tester beta of Mortalfin, a native Jellyfin client for jailbroken PS5 consoles. It appears under Media on the home screen.

What is new in beta 2
- Fixed: accented letters now show in the interface and in text subtitles: Czech, Polish, Hungarian, Turkish, Slovak and other European languages, plus Cyrillic
- Still the same: picture subtitles (PGS, DVD) work in every language

What is in this build
Video
- H.264 and HEVC (Main and Main 10), played from your server as they are
- AV1, decoded in software (dav1d)
- HDR10 is sent to your display as HDR10
- Dolby Vision plays as its HDR10 layer; other HDR is tone-mapped

Sound output
- Three modes: Auto, Bitstream and PCM
- Bitstream sends Dolby Digital, Dolby Digital Plus (including Atmos) and DTS core to your soundbar or receiver untouched
- Everything else is decoded in the console to PCM up to 7.1
- Soundbar delay to line the picture up with the sound

Audio formats
- Decoded to PCM: AAC, AC-3, E-AC-3, TrueHD, DTS, DTS-HD Master Audio, FLAC, Opus, MP3 and more
- TrueHD and DTS-HD Master Audio always play as lossless PCM; the PS5 audio output cannot carry them as they are

Subtitles
- Text subtitles from your server
- Picture subtitles (PGS, DVD) drawn by the app, placed in the black bar of a widescreen film when they fit
- Subtitle size, audio and subtitle language, and switching tracks while a film plays

Library and player
- Sign in with Quick Connect or user name and password
- Cover-wheel library, continue watching, next up, favourites and search
- Chapters, scrubbing, resume, and next episode automatically
- Playback info panel and HDR brightness control
- Optional Seerr requests

Known issues
- Greek, Romanian comma letters (ș ț), Vietnamese, Hebrew, Arabic, Thai, Japanese, Chinese and Korean are not in the text-subtitle font yet; use picture subtitles for those
- Plain http only: use your server's IP address and port
- No live TV, offline mode or music library yet
- No true 24p output

How to help
Install it, try your own films, and report bugs on Discord or GitHub with your firmware, your server version, the file's codecs and a klog. The README explains how.
